note: Barron County park on Red Cedar Lake, 1.5 miles north of Mikana, with a boat landing and docks, swimming area, playground and fish-cleaning house. Busy: it fills most weekends. ATVs and UTVs have been allowed on park roads since 2025. --Claude
summary: County page + all 36 site pages + 2026 policies PDF + map read. 36 public sites (not 38: 21-22 are the caretaker), 31 electric 20/30/50A with water at every site, $30 electric (tent-only $20), $5 reservation fee, 12-month window, 14-night max, walk-ins at the office (fcfs never -> always). Pit toilets + coin showers + dump. Lakeview KEPT (shore road between sites and water). Only 3 of 36 sites take monthly rentals.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT.
